description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework delivering Express‑level simplicity with Fastify‑grade performance—ideal for edge, serverless and AI‑powered APIs.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverages the 2026 shift to edge & serverless workloads by offering native ESM, full TypeScript typings, and compatibility with Bun/Deno while staying zero‑dependency. Daily builds (v0.0.202‑daily) guarantee the latest security patches and performance tweaks, positioning yantravese as the go‑to framework for modern, low‑latency services.
download_hooks: Blazing sub‑millisecond routing latency—up to 3× faster than Express and 1.5× faster than Fastify.
Zero external dependencies keep the bundle under 5 KB, eliminating supply‑chain risk and speeding up deployments.
Async‑first, type‑safe middleware with built‑in security headers gives a frictionless developer experience out of the box.
